environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLOVIN_CAMPAIGN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Campaign Management API key (AppLovin dashboard > your account, top right > Keys; not the Ad Unit Management key), sent as the raw `Authorization` header value on api.ads.axon.ai.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLOVIN_REPORT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Report Key (dashboard > account > Keys), sent as the api_key query parameter of GET https://r.applovin.com/report; needed only for get_report.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_APPLOVIN_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric AppLovin account id (dashboard > account > Go to settings: the number after the account name); every Campaign Management call carries it as ?account_id=.
